scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the active wheelchair-route timing walkthrough for Hillcrest Library’s upstairs voting-room setup before the opening packet closes.
Emerging Need: The walkthrough starts at the curb and lobby, then stops when the public elevator outage blocks the only observable wheelchair route upstairs.
Decision Context: Stair observations would not complete the same accessibility check, and a stored activity record identifies whether any supervised alternate route can still be used before packet lock.
Consequence: Timely help could preserve the started walkthrough for the morning handoff; after the opening packet locks, late route notes cannot serve that setup window.

parameter.title: Hillcrest Library access-route walkthrough
parameter.description: Pre-open wheelchair-route timing notes for the upstairs voting-room setup packet before the 10:00 observer arrival window.

parameter.content: We’re at Hillcrest with the tape wheel and clipboard. Your access-route walkthrough has started: curb cut, entry mat, and lobby turn width are recorded, and we’re heading to the public elevator next.

parameter.subject: Hillcrest north elevator service interruption
parameter.body: The north public elevator is out of service as of 09:10. A technician has been called. Please do not attempt a panel reset; stairs remain open for general building access.

parameter.content: The walkthrough is stopped at the lobby elevator bank. The voting room is upstairs, the public route can’t be timed without the elevator, and stair-only notes won’t complete the wheelchair-route check. The staff corridor door beside us is locked.

parameter.subject: Hillcrest opening packet locked
parameter.body: The Hillcrest opening packet was locked at 09:45 for the 10:00 observer arrival window. No additional access-route observations or escorted corridor checks can be inserted for this morning’s setup packet.
